items.reason: Detail `s` uses the same status-menu constructor and container actions as the row list.
Detail `y` opens the container’s Copy menu without copying immediately.
Detail `m` opens the Mute menu targeting the detail’s container.
Both surfaces dispatch `I` through the shared runFlatVerb helper.
Drain-picker rendering takes precedence over the open detail.
Direct `y` and `p` dispatch is removed from document peeks.
Neither detail list handles `p` directly.
Existing item and artifact `r` menu paths remain intact, including peeks.
The shared status refusal appears through the detail frame’s fallback flash.
The shared copy refusal appears through the detail frame’s fallback flash.
The shared mute refusal appears through the detail frame’s fallback flash.
Container menus occupy the detail frame’s reserved Block and reduce its list budget.
Detail container menus reuse the row-list navigation and entry dispatch handlers.
Menu Escape clears the menu while retaining the detail.
Detail openers target a single container and bypass Selection menu construction.
Detail search filters the displayed list, and Enter restores normal detail controls.
Shared matching implements case-insensitive substrings with AND-ed terms across id, title and type.
Item search fields exclude status.
Artifact filtering uses the shared grammar over name and type.
Escape discards the editing buffer and reapplies the previously committed term.
Reopening search creates an empty buffer; applying it restores all rows.
Typing routes printable keys, including j/k/v/r, into the detail’s text field.
Detail synchronization reapplies its active query after polling.
The applied search term appears in the detail header.
Empty search results name the query and explain how to clear it.
Artifact availability depends on the complete artifact collection, preserving list switching after filtering.
Detail search state is independent and disappears when the detail closes.
Detail hints advertise r/s/y/m and search, with flat copy hints removed.
Peek hints remove both flat copy keys.
Typing hints contain only apply, cancel and help.
Detail help omits the container’s `I` action even when its kind offers one.
Contextual help handles container menus over details and detail search typing separately.

scores.rationale: Clear reuse of existing dispatch, filtering and frame machinery with substantial tests; help omits `I`, and modal visibility and exact sizing lack focused regression coverage.
